product_metadata.title: Metal Barn Star, American Patriotic Star Wall Decoration Outdoor Indoor Hanging Wall Decor Star Ornament 21Inch (American Barn Star-E)
features: DIMENSIONS: Patriotic star decor measures 21 inches wide from tip to tip. Package includes 1 X patriotic decorations for the home star
STURDY AND DURABLE: Well made with nice quality metal, the metal star wall decor is sturdy and durable for long time use.
EASY TO HANG: It’s easy to hang the decorative American star on wall or door with assembled cord through pre-drilled hole.
WIDELY USED: The well painted rustic patriotic star can be widely used both indoor and outdoor, such as bedroom, kitchen, porch, yard, barn, garage, etc.
PATRIOTRIC GIFT: The red, white and blue themed metal star set makes a great gift for anyone, especially for a patriotic person.
description: American barn star was originally a good luck symbol for American farmers; now, the barn star is now a patriotic outdoor accent in red, white and blue Includes hook for displaying on home, garage or garden shed.
Patriotic Metal Barn Star American Flag Wall Decor July 4th Independence Day Memorial Day Decoration,Gift for Man.
